topic_title: Human Trafficking Awareness — The Julia Wells Act
prompt: Under Texas Penal Code §20A.02, what criminal offense classification applies to human trafficking?

options.text: Class C moving violation with a five-hundred-dollar municipal court fine
Class A misdemeanor with thirty days of weekend county probation work
First-degree felony punishable by 25 to 99 years or life in prison, up to $10,000 fine
Non-criminal civil litigation settled through private administrative mediation
